title: Chapter 6671: Save Me, Immortal!

Chapter 6671: Save Me, Immortal!

Chapter 6671: Save Me, Immortal!

Li Qiye appeared transparent while illuminated by all the immortal rays. He chuckled before narrowing his eyes.

The worm somehow noticed this and immediately closed its mouth, reverting to a single ray again. It let out a strange noise before returning to Bao Pu’s chest and shrinking to the size of a seed.

Bao Pu suffered a backlash from this, staggering backward and becoming unstable.

This development took everyone by surprise. They had expected an ultimate move from the disgusting worm. Was it afraid of Li Qiye, hence the attempt to hide?

Bao Pu couldn’t believe it. The worm was one with him, a part of his immortal dao. They shared the same fate and thoughts.

Therefore, the fear in the worm also resonated through him. Attempting to restrain surging emotions and churning vitality made him vomit blood.

This worm had never feared immortals, not primordial or any other type. This was proven with his success against the three immortals. However, it chose to hide from Li Qiye even before the battle.

“This is all you got? How shameful for an immortal.” Li Qiye said.

Li Qiye’s tone had not changed from start to finish, always speaking as if he were right. Alas, Bao Pu’s fear overwhelmed his pride.

The spectating overlords found this shocking. Bao Pu was suppressed already?

“It seems like you don’t have the privilege of picking how you die.” Li Qiye walked over.

Bao Pu seemed to be struck by lightning and tumbled backward. Since the worm didn’t dare to come out, he couldn’t use his immortal dao, meaning he had nothing like a scholar facing a rampaging army.

“Immortals, save me!” He threw away his dignity and begged for help.

“Rumble!” Two primordial beams erupted from Three Immortals and entered space.

Radiant halos emanated from the two redemption grounds as they became the center.

“Ancient immortals.” Inhabitants became afraid to see their activation and dropped to the ground.

“A repeat of Immortal Slaughtered and Heavenslay...” Emperors and desolate gods were scared out of their mind as well.

This only happened twice during the two immortal wars. Cracking noises could be heard everywhere from their powers.

“Please don’t happen in Three Immortals.” A primal ancestor murmured.

The previous wars occurred on an independent battlefield. Nevertheless, Three Immortals still suffered devastating damage from them.

“I am here, Fellow Daoist.” Ancient voices came from the river of time—a spot before the beginning of heaven and earth.

They pierced through the river and reached the present.
